questions.title: GMT to 30° West
questions.question: It is 12:00 Noon at Greenwich (0°). What time is it at a station 30° West?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 30° ÷ 15 = 2 Hours.
Step 2: West is Behind. Subtract.
Step 3: 12:00 - 2 hours = 10:00 AM.

questions.title: Accra to New York
questions.question: Accra is at 0°. New York is approx 75° West. If it is 5:00 PM in Accra, what time is it in New York?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 75° ÷ 15 = 5 Hours.
Step 2: New York is West (Behind). Subtract.
Step 3: 5:00 PM - 5 hours = 12:00 Noon.

questions.title: GMT to Brazil
questions.question: It is 10:00 AM in London (0°). What time is it in Brasilia (45° West)?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 45° ÷ 15 = 3 Hours.
Step 2: Subtract 3 hours from 10:00 AM.
Answer: 7:00 AM.

questions.title: Early Morning Calculation
questions.question: It is 6:00 AM at Greenwich. What time is it at 90° West?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 90° ÷ 15 = 6 Hours.
Step 2: 6:00 AM - 6 hours = 0:00.
Answer: 12:00 Midnight (The previous day).
